scope: Independent frozen-source, payload, inverse and saved postwrite/browser evidence review for the two-file V6 update.

reviewerPerformed: Recomputed source and payload hashes, sizes, manifest differences and rollback bindings.
Compared all 527 local candidate and recorded Theme Check copy files with the postwrite API manifest.
Compared saved Japanese/English/French/Korean rendered paragraphs with frozen source bodies.
Compared every recorded Arabic child/adult guide measurement with its source row, allowing only existing Arabic unit-label normalization to kg/cm.
Inspected recorded test outputs and root browser evidence, including first-child cart identity/price and cleanup.
rootPerformed: Actual browser navigation, interaction, viewport changes and cart add/remove.
42 production-script regressions and full 527-file Shopify Theme Check.
Live full embedded-variant/options/table before/after equality comparisons reported in browser-after.json.
reviewerDidNotPerform: No independent live browser replay or external action.
No test rerun, theme/product/canonical edit or publication.

payloads.verification: Both payloads target only the same unpublished theme and exactly the same two TEXT files. Apply bodies equal frozen candidate bytes. Rollback bodies match fresh prewrite API MD5 and size; cleanup also equals the inline source.
payloads.largeAssetProvenance: The API omitted the large ruler JS inline body. Its inverse comes from the V5 local Theme Check copy, bound to current before/prewrite API MD5 and size. Postwrite JS verification uses the API MD5/size, not an independently returned full text body.

sourceVerification.scopeNote: The complete preview inherits prior combined-theme work; this review is not an exhaustive re-audit of the full 59-difference MAIN release.

validationEvidence.relevance: Tests reproduce missing Arabic offers and Japanese stripping in baseline code, exercise the actual script, preserve 20 other locale role/guide outputs, retain tables and offer properties, and cover bounded matching, unavailable offers and cleanup protections.

arabic.guideMeasurementComparison: All saved visible measurement values equal source values. Header comparison applies only the existing normalization of Arabic kg/cm unit labels.

selectedGuideRecheck.screenshotInspection: Root visually inspected the S highlight in the CUA transcript; reviewer did not independently inspect that screenshot or replay the browser.

findings.type: Report versus browser-evidence inconsistency; source payload has no mismatch
findings.evidence: READBACK.md states adult S/white showed measurements 102/52/64. browser-after.json arabic.adultAfter.selection begins with 126/63/76, the 4XL source values, while its add summary names adult S at 26.99. The complete recorded guide contains correct source rows.
findings.interpretation: The saved combined text may reflect interaction timing or different surfaces. This evidence alone does not establish a new selector defect, but does not substantiate the specific settled adult-S measurement claim.
findings.requestedResolution: Root verifies the settled adult-S measurement summary and records the result, or narrows the report claim to the guide values actually evidenced. Do not change candidate source without a reproduced defect.
findings.resolution: Fresh root mobile DOM evidence captures only the visible tr.is-selected row: S,40-50,150-160,102,52,64; selected color is white, price2699, add enabled, cart0. Reviewer independently compared the saved row against the frozen Arabic source and price against the captured adult-S/white variant. READBACK.md now explains that the earlier sliced parent text contained all rows. No source defect was reproduced and both candidate hashes remain unchanged.

limitations: Browser QA and live embedded-object/table equality were performed by root, not replayed by this reviewer. Browser JSON records equality results rather than full raw before/after variant and table arrays.
One child cart addition was exercised and removed. Exhaustive offer mapping relies on production-script fixtures plus root's live embedded-variant comparison.
The root repeated a mobile role click after initial rendering superseded the first attempt; the completed-selector interaction passed.
Mobile emulation is not physical-device certification. Current English-page console results do not cover every locale.
No payment/order, PageSpeed improvement, conversion lift, or perfect-website certification is established.
No publication approval is granted; owner publication remains separate and requires a fresh MAIN conflict check.
nextAction: Root integrates this scoped PASS and the resolved V6-REVIEW-01 history into its owning handoff; canonical integration/checks remain root-owned. No publication approval is granted.
